_comment: Slack app manifest for claudex (r-docs Slack bot). Import at api.slack.com/apps → Create New App → From a manifest. Replace APP_URL with the deployment's public origin. Scopes must match SLACK_BOT_SCOPES in lib/slack/installations.ts. Then: enable Socket Mode and create an app-level token (connections:write) → SLACK_APP_TOKEN; install to the home workspace → SLACK_BOT_TOKEN; Basic Information → Client ID/Secret → SLACK_CLIENT_ID/SLACK_CLIENT_SECRET (needed only for installing into OTHER workspaces via /api/slack/install; keep 'Public Distribution' unactivated / not submitted to the App Directory — the OAuth link alone lets an invited workspace admin install it).
